select distinct submit_user_id from oj_lesson_paper_evaluate

select count(p.resource_id) as operationPracticeCount, count(t.resource_id) as theoryPracticeCount from oj_practice_solved s left join oj_practice_theory t on t.resource_id = s.practice_id left join oj_practice_operation p on p.resource_id = s.practice_id where s.submit_user_id = #{userId}

select resource_id from oj_course_lesson
where type = #{lessonType}

select count(distinct oj_course_lesson.resource_id) as lessonAllCount, SUM(case when oj_course_lesson.type = 0 then 1 END)as theoryLessonCount , SUM(case when oj_course_lesson.type = 1 then 1 END ) as expLessonCount from oj_course_lesson join oj_course on oj_course.resource_id = oj_course_lesson.course_id
